stories.text: 🚨 RULED OUT: R. Rice won't play, and he's in Kyle Tucker's starting lineup. Kickoff's Sunday 4:25 PM. Clock's ticking.
🎯 Gibb it to Me Baby has moved into the median race — 46% to finish above it.
⚡ Early edge: 49er Faith-Fool went from 19% to 46% against Claremont In Yo Stace!, led by Dobbins (13.60 pts).
🔮 Gibb it to Me Baby vs Kyle Tucker is tightening — the projected margin shrank to 18.40 pts.
😅 TDsMaGee is sweating out a close one with Mr. Action Jackson (47% to win). Starting RJ Harvey (14.60 pts) over Emanuel Wilson (5.20 pts) would have helped.
🗑️ DROP REGRET: Drake Maye averaged 7.5 before 49er Faith-Fool cut him in Week 4. Since: 33.3 a week. Now he's helping Brock You Like a Hurricane.
🏟️ Game to watch: ARI @ LAR (Sunday 4:05 PM), 9 league starters in action with 139.36 pts up for grabs. It could swing TDsMaGee vs Mr. Action Jackson by 35%.
📺 Up next, Sunday 9:30 AM (HOU VS JAX): 9 league starters in action. Most riding on it: Ramosverse vs Kirbo Crushers (35.61 pts projected).
🪑 LONG-TERM REGRET: Kirbo Crushers has started Khalil Shakir just once. Starting him in Weeks 1, 4 and 5 would have meant 2 more wins by now (+27.70 pts).
🚮 POINTS ABANDONED: Players 49er Faith-Fool has cut this season have scored 92.62 pts since, led by Maye (66.62 pts) and Borregales (26.00 pts).
🧾 The waiver dust has settled: 8 claims went through. Top prize: Matt Gay (K, proj 10.71 pts) to TDsMaGee, who cut Harrison Mevis to make room.
🛍️ TDsMaGee went waiver shopping: Tyler Higbee and Matt Gay. Rebuild in progress.
📈 49er Faith-Fool was down to 16% against The Mahomies — and won.
